name: Santa Fe, New Mexico
why: Adobe architecture, galleries around Canyon Road, chile-heavy food, and easy half-day hikes.
logistics: Fly into ABQ for better fares, rent a car or shuttle 65 minutes to Santa Fe.

name: Mexico City, Mexico

weather.summary: Warm afternoons with a small storm risk

why: World-class food, Roma/Condesa walks, Chapultepec museums, and a strong long-weekend rhythm.
logistics: Nonstop or one-stop flights are common from ORD; rideshares work well in core neighborhoods.
bookingNotes: Pick Roma Norte or Condesa to keep transit simple.

name: San Diego, California
why: Easy weather, Balboa Park, tacos, beaches, and a low-friction airport close to town.
logistics: Stay in Little Italy, North Park, or Mission Beach depending on food versus beach priority.
bookingNotes: Hotel prices rise near waterfront events.
Transit is fine downtown; car helps for beach hops.

name: Portland, Maine
why: Compact harbor walks, seafood, breweries, and an easy pace for a short reset.
logistics: One-stop flights from ORD are common; Old Port hotels keep the weekend car-light.
bookingNotes: Restaurant reservations matter for peak dinner times.

name: Denver, Colorado

weather.summary: Warm days, cool nights, mountain weather variable

why: Direct flights, mountain access, RiNo food halls, and a clean split between city and outdoors.
logistics: Airport train reaches downtown; rent a car only for foothills or mountain day trips.
bookingNotes: Altitude is noticeable on day one.
